title: Nature of Jesus' Humanity
english: From the interpretation of the 14th Psalm. But truly, the experience of the two Jesuses was had. For it became even in the field of human souls, and being outside of flesh, it lives and endured. Therefore, a rational [being], and of the same substance with the souls of men, just as also the flesh is of the same substance with that of [...]
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: The Uniqueness of the Person
english: He comes to be in human flesh, having come forth from Mary. [This is] Eustathius of Antioch, from the commentary on the 14th Psalm: God sent out His Son having come from a woman (Psalm 2:7). Not 'having come' [plural], but 'having come' [singular]; for the person is unique; he did not say 'unique' in nature.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Unity of Essence and Distinction of Natures
english: Stop, may it never be; neither [did I say] the same essence of flesh and divinity, but I said one Lord Jesus Christ, through whom all things, in the distinction of the natures, are being made known through all things.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
